question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He **returned back** to his hometown after many years.
solution:
The correct answer is '**returned**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**returned**" is sufficient and correct to convey the action of going back to a place.
 
• The use of "back" after "returned" is redundant because "returned" already implies going back.
 
• **Options 1**, **3**, and **4** are either redundant or grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He **returned**__ to his hometown after many years."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "returned again"** is redundant because "returned" already implies going back.
 
• **Option 3: "came back"** is grammatically correct but does not directly replace the original word.
 
• **Option 4: "has returned back"** is incorrect due to redundancy ("returned" and "back" together are not needed).
